check.description: No loss of content or functionality when the user overrides text spacing: line height 1.5x font size, paragraph spacing 2x, letter spacing 0.12x, word spacing 0.16x.

sources.internal_policy_ref: HSBC digital accessibility framework — WCAG 2.2 AA minimum, governed by Group Digital Experience and Accessibility (mandatory on all HSBC digital projects).

external_automatable_refs.description: Ensure that text spacing set through style attributes can be adjusted with custom stylesheets
